title: Concept: WKWebView loads a computed URL request in swift — review required
description: In swift, WKWebView is told to load a request built from runtime data. Web content shares the app process boundaries with the script message handlers, so the loaded origin can call whatever the app exposed. Universal links and custom schemes deliver attacker-chosen values without any user typing.
applicability: swift iOS apps that render remote content.
risk: Navigation to attacker content with handler exposure; MEDIUM severity.
